title: There Or Not
paragraphs: “Keel-kun, you’re so cute.”
“I’m cool!”
Mysteriously, Luna-chan’s coloration… has turned out the same as the time before last! She’s still frolicking around Keel as usual.
“Luna also… wants to be like Keel-kun.”
“Oh? You admire me that much? Man, I’m so happy!”
Keel wagged his tail furiously as he replied. He looked just like a dog devoted to its master. At that moment, big sister, her friend, and Kou passed by.
“I want to be like Rifana too.”
“What’s going on?”
“Well, Luna-chan seems to respect me a lot!”
“I see. Luna wants to… be cute like Keel and Rifana.”
“What!?”

As I watched Luna-chan, I was thinking about the difference from last time. Why was Luna-chan’s color different last time? The mystery only deepens. There are also a few other kids whose colors are slightly different. There must be… some reason behind this.
“What’s wrong, Motoyasu?”
“Luna-chan’s coloration is different from last time. Ah, but it’s the same as the time before last. Her personality is also the same as before.”
“Hmm… maybe something in the environment caused the change? Like the food she ate or the situation around her?”
The food, perhaps? Everything Luna-chan ate after she was born was prepared by Father, and there’s not much difference between what we all eat. In that case! The difference from last time is—
“It’s whether Keel was around or not!”
“Really? So, you’re saying Luna-chan’s color changes depending on whether Keel-kun is there?”
“Exactly! Last time, she was friendly with Mole. She loved playing in the dirt. But what about this time?”
“Hmm… now she’s playing around with Keel-kun. And with Rifana-chan too.”
“That’s it.”
“I see. So, she’s compatible with Keel-kun.”
When Father muttered that, Luna-chan glanced at us before rushing toward Keel.
“That’s how it is. Luna and Keel-kun are bound by fate… Luna wants to get along with Keel-kun.”
“W-well, I guess that’s fine. Let’s get along from now on!”
“She seems more assertive than she was the time before last.”
The previous Luna-chan seemed to take things more step by step. Luna-chan transformed into her chick mode and perched herself on Keel’s head. That’s her designated spot.
“Shield and spear hero—what should we do about modifying the bioplant?”

Ah, right. Since the village’s development had progressed to a certain point, we used the bioplant seeds and the influence from Faubrey to recruit a chief physician. He occasionally returns to Faubrey’s research institute, but he seems quite enthusiastic about being here. This time, I won’t let the homunculus research lab interfere.
“I was surprised when he suddenly showed up, but it’s not a bad thing. Thanks to the heroes’ power, traveling between Faubrey and Melromarc is instant, and it should also be helpful for fieldwork.”
“I’ve already mapped out most of the countries around the world with the portal. So, we made a deal for him to help with the development.”
“I know. And while he’s at it, he’ll be doing health checks for the Filolials, right? Honestly, the Filolials raised by the heroes grow in such strange ways.”

As the chief physician said this, he was examining Luna-chan. At first, Luna-chan tried to run away, but it seems she stopped herself, thinking she couldn’t show such a pathetic side to Keel. I asked the chief physician to modify the bioplant. I want him to create something like the convenient houses that existed in the first world.
“Alright then.”
In the village square, Ren and Itsuki were grouping the Filolials and the village’s slaves into teams. What are they doing?
“Naofumi, and Motoyasu.”
“Hm? What’s up?”
Father and I approached Ren and Itsuki. Of course, big sister, her friend, and Keel came along as well.
“The class-up for the villagers went smoothly, so we were thinking of going on an expedition to raise their levels. What about you guys?”
“Ah… I get that it’s to prepare for the waves, but is it really okay for the village kids to keep challenging them?”
When Father asked with concern, the village kids nodded.
“Of course, big bro! We’re going to challenge the waves… and become strong enough to help you guys!”
“Yeah. We want to help the heroes who took back our village!”
“Oh my.”
Big sister’s big sister smiled as she watched them.

“Well… I guess it’s fine. According to the Queen, it’s dangerous to train Melromarc’s soldiers right now, and Faubrey is dealing with internal conflicts, trying to purge the soldiers who were loyal to the former Takt faction.”
“If we’re going to make good use of our time, the villagers are our best bet.”
“I don’t mind if it’s people who won’t harm us or the villagers… but making that judgment is difficult.”

Come to think of it, in the previous loop, training the soldiers was something that happened much later. I vaguely recall Father and the others doing a bit of that on Cal Mira Island and in the North Ferrato Great Forest.
“If Motoyasu trusts them, then I guess it’s fine to train them.”
“Unfortunately, it’s hard for me to remember every individual in detail.”
“You say that, but you remember all the Filolials by their scent!”
Ren made a sharp remark. It’s rude to compare the great Filolials to some random soldiers!
“Well, well, Motoyasu-kun just loves Filolials…”
“That’s right… If I base it on the previous loops, then the mole tribe, Éclair, Panda, and their subordinates…”
It’s not time for Stalker Pig yet. When the time comes, I’ll discreetly inform Itsuki.
“The people of Siltvelt can be somewhat trusted. However, Father… or rather, the Shield Hero, is so deeply revered there that they once tried to poison the Filolials. So, they can be dangerous.”
“Either way, it’s a difficult time to be training private soldiers…”
“It’s not like we’re completely surrounded, though.”
“If Motoyasu remembered the details a bit better, this would be easier.”
“Come on, let’s just do our best for now. If we strengthen our forces through expeditions, it’ll be fine.”
Father’s words made Ren and Itsuki nod in agreement. Indeed. We’re going to build an even stronger organization than in the previous loop.
“Oh my.”
“Sadeena-san, you’re going to help out too, right? We might get some good materials from sea monsters.”
“If it’s within range where I can get back to the village quickly, sure. Who’s coming with big sister?”
I didn’t miss the slight twitch in Ren’s gaze as he looked away.
“Come to think of it, Ren can’t swim. That’s something I confirmed in the previous loops.”
“I can swim!”
“Oh my, then Ren-chan is coming with big sister?”
“N-No! I’ll go to the hunting grounds I want and level these guys up! I’ll leave that to someone else!”
Ren refused, but Father and Itsuki were clearly exasperated by his reaction. Well, it’s obvious he can’t swim.
“Ren-san, that’s pretty much the same as admitting you can’t swim…”
“Yeah. So Ren’s a sinker, huh?”
“I said I can swim!”
“Then shall we swim at the beach? Of course, we’ll visit big sister’s secret base while we’re at it.”
“Oh my… you even know about that?”
That’s a spot I clearly remember from the previous loop. It’s the perfect place for a date with Filo-tan.
“Wow, Sadeena big sister’s secret base? I remember her mentioning it before!”
Big sister’s friend said excitedly, her eyes sparkling. Oh? So she knows about that place? From the looks of it, she hasn’t been there yet.
“N-No way! I just want to go hunting quickly!”
“Ren, calm down. You’re not hiding it very well.”
“I said I can swim!”
“Okay, okay.”
Father was patiently calming Ren down.
“For now, I think Naofumi should go with Sadeena-san. People from this region are naturally good swimmers.”
“Hmm…?”
Sakura-chan, who had been dozing off, turned her gaze towards the beach.
“Underwater battle?”
“Looks like it. Is everyone okay with that?”
“I’m fine. What about Rifana-chan?”
“I-I’d like to practice my magic…”
“Got it. Since it’s close to the village, I’ll gather materials from the sea. Ren, Itsuki, and Motoyasu-kun, you guys gather materials and help level up the others.”
And so, we all set out on our respective expeditions.
